PROPERTY TAX-DEFAULT (DELINQUENT) LIST (Revenue & Tax Section 3371)
The real property (parcels) listed below have at least one installment of property taxes over three (3) years old and were
declared to be in tax-default at 12:01 a.m. on July 1, 2023, by operation of law, pursuant to Revenue & Taxation Code section
3436. The property taxes, assessments, penalties and costs on these parcels levied in fiscal year 2022-2023 became
delinquent due to nonpayment of the total amount.
The amounts to redeem (pay in full) the tax-defaulted parcels are shown opposite the parcel numbers next to the name of the
assessee and represent the amount due as of the date of this publication.
